name: Estel Alfheim
original_name: エステル＝アルフヘイム
source:
Princess of Alfheim, a kingdom of elves. She is a skilled swordswoman who wields dual mithril-silver swords with deadly proficiency.

She has a brusque personality and is inflexible and stubborn. Despite her manly personality, her appearance is breathtakingly beautiful and captivates all who see her. 

She has flowing golden hair, breasts so full that it is hard to believe that she is an elf, and a toned, supple body line.

She is worried about the invasion from the north, and travels in the surrounding areas of Alfheim requesting reinforcements. She is asked by the King of a Kingdom to offer her body in exchange for reinforcements.

[From [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill05/chara.html]official site[/url]]
